The customer is asking about changing a delivery address after the order has shipped. Let me check the handbook for this information.

From PART 3.1 "Changing a delivery address":
"Customers can change the delivery address of an order until it ships. Open the order in the account area and choose Edit address. Once the order has shipped, the address can only be changed with the carrier, using the tracking link in the shipping email. Never change an address over chat without confirming the email address on the account."

So the answer is: Yes, but only through the carrier using the tracking link in the shipping email. They cannot change it through the account area after shipping.

I should be friendly and direct, start with the answer, then the one step they take next.

content.text: Yes, you can change it with the carrier using the tracking link in your shipping email. Once your order has shipped, you'll no longer be able to edit the address in your account area, but the carrier will give you the option to update it through their tracking page.
